entries.basis: Scored the 6.2L V8 High Country crew cab: 420 hp =3.8; 0-60 mph 5.4 s Car and Driver test =3.1; EPA 16/20/17 mpg combined (fueleconomy.gov 2019 K10 4WD 6.2) =0.5; handling 2.5 (agile for its size per Autotrader.ca, but bouncy and unrefined per Car and Driver); space 4 for a full-size crew cab with spacious rear seats per Auto123; value 420 hp / $54.5k = 7.7 hp per $1k =3.4.
